question: Which of the following is an example of a vibrating body producing sound?
solution:
The correct answer is __**A ringing tuning fork**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sound** is a form of **energy** that is produced when an object **vibrates**. A vibration is defined as a rapid, periodic **back-and-forth motion** of an object about its mean position.
 
• A **ringing tuning fork** is a classic example of a **vibrating body** producing sound. When the **prongs** of the fork are struck, they oscillate at a specific **frequency**, disturbing the air molecules around them and creating **audible sound waves**. ***Hence, statement 2 is correct.***
 
• While a **moving car** contains various components like an **engine** that vibrates, the motion of the car itself is **translational**. In physics problems of this nature, the tuning fork is the most accurate representation of a simple vibrating source. ***Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.***
